name: Partial Trace Turns a Point Coefficient Space into an Interval
definition: Start with the singleton class $C=\{0\}\subseteq\{0,1\}$ and partially trace its coordinate, obtaining the three-state path $\{(0,0),(0,1),(1,1)\}$.
properties: The singleton coefficient space is a point. The path has the sole missing pattern $(x,m)=(1,0)$, and every normalized row $(1/(1+u),u/(1+u))$ with $u>0$ is feasible; its coefficient space is an open interval. Full cubes remain one-point coefficient spaces under mask addition.
